mapper.select: SELECT , u.nick_name AS photographer_nick_name, i.local_url AS stored_url FROM project_photo p INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = p.photographer_user_id INNER JOIN image i ON i.id = p.image_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.id = #{photoId}

SELECT , u.nick_name AS photographer_nick_name, i.local_url AS stored_url FROM project_photo p INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = p.photographer_user_id INNER JOIN image i ON i.id = p.image_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY p.taken_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_photo (project_id, image_id, photographer_user_id, taken_at, timezone, note, location_text, latitude, longitude, coordinate_system, location_accuracy_m, location_captured_at, gps_status, geocode_status, weather_text, temperature_c, humidity_percent, weather_code, weather_provider, weather_observed_at, weather_status, watermark_position, watermark_visible, project_name_snapshot, width_px, height_px, client_request_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{imageId}, #{photographerUserId}, #{takenAt}, #{timezone}, #{note}, #{locationText}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{coordinateSystem}, #{locationAccuracyM}, #{locationCapturedAt}, #{gpsStatus}, #{geocodeStatus}, #{weatherText}, #{temperatureC}, #{humidityPercent}, #{weatherCode}, #{weatherProvider}, #{weatherObservedAt}, #{weatherStatus}, #{watermarkPosition}, #{watermarkVisible}, #{projectNameSnapshot}, #{widthPx}, #{heightPx}, #{clientRequestId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
